title: METR 2026: self-reported uplift vs measured upper bounds still diverge
summary: METR 2026 work: transcript analysis gives only a soft upper bound (1.5x-13x) on time savings while a 349-worker survey reports median 1.4-2x self-reported value change, with task-substitution inflation acknowledged; perception vs measurement divergence in AI productivity persists.

evidence.summary: Self-reported uplift and measured upper bounds remain far apart; substitution effects inflate estimates.
